deals.travelWindow: Sep 2026 – Feb 2027, cheapest on scattered off-peak dates (e.g. Nov 14)
deals.whyRanked: One-way legs as low as $62 ($120-150 RT) on Allegiant's own site — still the cheapest verified fare of the five, with the Smokies' Greenbrier entrance 45 minutes away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to explore solo on foot, and the park's Greenbrier and Cosby entrances offer quiet trails away from the Cades Cove crowds.

highlights: Market Square farmers market and street performers
Sunsphere observation deck over World's Fair Park
Ijams Nature Center quarry swimming hole
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Greenbrier entrance
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square and the Sunsphere, dinner in the Old City.
Day 2 — Ijams Nature Center trails in the morning, Mabry-Hazen House and downtown murals in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Greenbrier: the Ramsey Cascades or Porters Creek trailhead before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and Ijams are walkable or a short rideshare apart; a rental car is required to reach the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square or Gay Street — walkable, close to restaurants and the Tennessee Theatre.

deals.travelWindow: Through winter 2026/27, cheapest on scattered dates (e.g. Dec 11)
deals.whyRanked: New pick: one-way legs as low as $67 ($130-160 RT) confirmed on Allegiant's own booking page, and it's arguably the best park-and-solo double of the five — Blue Ridge Parkway trailheads minutes from a walkable downtown.
deals.soloWhy: A dense, walkable downtown with breweries and galleries, plus Blue Ridge Parkway overlooks reachable without a long drive.

highlights: River Arts District galleries and studios
Chimney Rock and Lake Lure day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown walking tour: Pack Square, Grove Arcade, brewery crawl on the South Slope.
Day 2 — Blue Ridge Parkway drive to the Folk Art Center and Craggy Gardens overlook.
Day 3 — River Arts District galleries in the morning, Biltmore Estate gardens before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and the River Arts District are walkable or a short rideshare apart; a rental car is needed for the Parkway and Chimney Rock.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Pack Square — walkable to restaurants, breweries, and the S&W Market food hall.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 20 – Nov 14, cheapest on Tue/Wed departures
deals.whyRanked: One-way legs as low as $80 ($150-190 RT) confirmed live on JetBlue's own site for October/November dates, with Everglades day trips an hour inland.
deals.soloWhy: Las Olas Boulevard and the beachfront promenade are walkable and busy well into the evening, with the free Sun Trolley covering downtown.

highlights: Las Olas Boulevard shops and cafes
Riverwalk and the NSU Art Museum
itinerary: Day 1 — Beachfront promenade walk, Las Olas Boulevard for dinner.
Day 2 — Everglades NP Shark Valley: rent a bike for the 15-mile paved loop, alligators guaranteed.
Day 3 — Riverwalk and NSU Art Museum in the morning, Bonnet House gardens before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free Sun Trolley covers downtown and the beach; a rental car is worth it for the Everglades day trip.
guide.stayArea: Las Olas or the beachfront — walkable, close to restaurants and the water taxi stops.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 26 onward, cheapest on off-peak dates
deals.whyRanked: One-way legs as low as $119 ($220-260 RT) confirmed live on JetBlue's site — up from the $179 RT seen earlier this week, but Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor is still just 90 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: A compact, walkable downtown with a free shuttle, plus an easy mountain day trip that needs no technical hiking skill.

itinerary: Day 1 — Union Station, 16th Street Mall, RiNo Art District mural walk.
Day 2 — Day trip to Rocky Mountain NP for the Bear Lake corridor (in-park shuttle handles the parking).
Day 3 — Denver Botanic Gardens in the morning, Larimer Square for dinner.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with a free 16th Street shuttle; a rental car is worth it for the Rocky Mountain NP day trip.
guide.stayArea: LoDo (Lower Downtown) — near Union Station and walkable to RiNo.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 21 2026 – Feb 2027, cheapest on off-peak dates
deals.whyRanked: One-way legs as low as $129 ($240-280 RT) confirmed live on JetBlue's site, with Cabrillo National Monument and Torrey Pines each a short trolley-and-drive from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Balboa Park, the Gaslamp Quarter, and the coastal trolley make this one of the most solo-friendly warm-weather cities in the country.

itinerary: Day 1 — Balboa Park museums and Botanical Garden, Gaslamp Quarter for dinner.
Day 2 — Cabrillo National Monument tide pools and the Old Point Loma Lighthouse, sunset at Sunset Cliffs.
Day 3 — Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve hike, La Jolla Cove seals, trolley back downtown.
guide.gettingAround: The MTS trolley and buses cover downtown, Old Town, and the beaches; a car isn't required but helps reach Torrey Pines faster.
guide.stayArea: Gaslamp Quarter or Little Italy — walkable, trolley-accessible, close to the bay.
